title: Product Design Engineer- 4+ years of experience
description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

**About the Role**

* We are looking for a hands-on **Product Designer** to join the **Unified Management Portal desig**n team and help shape the unified experience that powers our product portfolio.
* The Unified Management Portal consolidates SonicWall's network, endpoint, email, and cloud security products into a single portal with shared SSO, navigation, and design system — a major product reset.
* This is a B2B, enterprise-grade product design role — not consumer. The designer will design for IT administrators, security analysts, network engineers, and managed service provider partners who manage security for organizations of every size, from SMBs to global enterprises.
* The work centers on density, configurability, scale, and operational reliability — not consumer-style minimalism or marketing surfaces.
* This is a builder's role on a small, senior team. The designer will own design end to end for product areas with significant business impact, partner closely with Product and Engineering, and work in an AI-augmented design environment where Claude and other AI tools are part of the daily workflow.

**What You'll Do**

* Own end-to-end design for one or more Unified Management Portal product areas, from discovery and information architecture through interaction design, visual polish, prototyping, and design QA.
* Design complex enterprise workflows including policy builders, dashboards, configuration wizards, multi-tenant management, alerting, and incident response screens.
* Build and maintain components, tokens, and patterns in the Unified Management Portal Figma design system.
* Generate working interactive prototypes using AI tools such as Claude, v0, Figma Make, and similar tools.
* Use Claude across the design workflow, including prototype generation, design-system documentation, research synthesis, content design, and competitive analysis.
* Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Leads, and Solution Architects across time zones.
* Contribute to design-system governance and documentation as the platform scales across product lines.
* Conduct usability reviews and design critiques, raising the quality bar across the team.

**What We're Looking For**

* 4–7 years of product design experience in B2B, enterprise SaaS. Consumer-only backgrounds are unlikely to be a strong fit.
* Expert-level proficiency in Figma, including auto-layout, variables, component libraries, variants, branching, and design-system contribution.
* Demonstrated fluency with Claude as a working tool in the design process, not as a novelty.
* Working experience with at least one AI prototyping environment such as v0, Lovable, Bolt, Framer AI, or Figma Make.
* Strong systems thinking and comfort designing within and contributing to a large, evolving design system.
* Ability to design complex, information-dense enterprise workflows with clarity, balancing power-user depth with accessibility for less technical users.
* A portfolio with shipped B2B or enterprise SaaS work demonstrating decision-making, not just final visuals.
* Strong written communication skills for working asynchronously across time zones.
* Comfortable working independently and driving design direction with limited oversight.
* Cybersecurity, networking, or infrastructure product experience is a strong plus, but not required. We can teach the domain; we cannot teach taste and judgment.
* Experience with MSSP or multi-tenant admin workflows is a bonus.
* A clear point of view on how AI changes product design, and where its limits are.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree with 4+ years of relevant experience.
* Degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Visual Communication, or related field preferred.

*Reporting Operations*

* Maintain reporting controls documentation and coordinate monthly control execution activities.

Perform and document reporting controls, ensuring evidence is retained and maintained in accordance with governance and assurance requirements.

* Translate business requirements into detailed functional and technical requirements for delivery teams, ensuring traceability from requirement through to implementation.

* Lead requirements workshops and impact assessments across sustainability processes, data models and reporting solutions.

* Support solution design activities in collaboration with Sustainability Business Stakeholders, Product Owners, Architects, MSM engineers and Data Foundation engineering teams.

* Support testing activities, including system integration testing, user acceptance testing and regression testing, ensuring solutions meet business requirements before deployment.

* Investigate and resolve complex sustainability reporting issues, coordinating activities across multiple teams to identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.

* Facilitate decision making where process, system or data issues span multiple stakeholder groups.

* Experience working with sustainability, or non‑financial performance data, including data extraction, validation, and reconciliation across multiple systems.
* Demonstrated capability running data quality checks, QA validation, and control processes to support accurate and assurance‑ready reporting.
* Hands‑on experience maintaining data flows, interfaces, or integrations between source systems and reporting or analytics tools.
* Experience supporting internal performance reporting or external disclosures through the preparation, review, and documentation of sustainability metrics and datasets.
* Proven experience gathering, documenting and managing business and functional requirements. Experience translating business and functional requirements into technical specifications for development teams.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with the ability to investigate complex data, process and technology issues.
Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and coordinate resolution across multiple stakeholder groups.  

  
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting metric ownership, methodology documentation and reporting governance processes.
* Experience working with sustainability or non‑financial data within Microsoft‑based technology environments, including data extraction and validation from source systems into platforms such as Microsoft Sustainability Manager, Azure data services, or Power Platform tools.
* Demonstrated capability using data quality controls, reconciliations, and QA processes within Microsoft technologies, such as Azure Data Factory, Dataverse, or Power BI datasets.

description:
**Netradyne** harnesses the power of Computer Vision and Edge Computing to revolutionize the modern-day transportation ecosystem. We are a leader in fleet safety solutions. **Senior QA Engineer - Vehicle Networks and Telematics**
========================================================

  

**Role Overview**

As a Senior QA Engineer in the CAN QA team, you will own validation of how our devices read, interpret and report vehicle data, from the CAN bus through the device to the cloud. You will develop test strategies for J1939 and OBD-II integrations, automate protocol and signal-level testing, investigate complex field issues, and provide evidence-based release-readiness recommendations.

This is a hands-on role for someone equally at home with a CAN trace, a bench power supply and a truck cab, and who can convert requirements, DBCs, logs and field evidence into reliable qualification coverage.

  

**What You Will Own**

* Validation strategy and release qualification for CAN-based vehicle features, new vehicle onboarding and customer configurations.
* Requirement-to-test coverage for vehicle signals, diagnostics, power modes and end-to-end telematics workflows.
* Root-cause investigation of signal mismatches, intermittent CAN failures and vehicle-specific field issues.
* Reusable CAN simulation, trace replay, fault-injection and automated regression capabilities.
* Technical guidance through test-design reviews, automation reviews and structured defect triage.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Vehicle Networks and Diagnostics**

* Validate SAE J1939 PGN/SPN decoding for vehicle speed, odometer, engine hours, fuel, DM1/DM2 faults and other supported signals.
* Validate OBD-II modes, PIDs, DTCs and VIN handling using SAE J1979 and ISO 15765-4.
* Verify scaling, offsets, units, ranges, rollover, timeouts, stale data, source-address handling and not-available values.
* Test J1939 transport protocol (BAM and RTS/CTS), request messages, address claim and bus-off recovery.
* Correlate device-decoded values with trusted CAN tools and OEM or dealer diagnostic systems.

  

**Power Modes and CAN Wake-up**

* Validate wake-up on CAN traffic and ignition, sleep after bus silence, shutdown and recovery across supported configurations.
* Measure quiescent current and verify that the device causes no unwanted wake-ups, excessive bus traffic or vehicle battery drain.
* Validate ignition (KL15) and battery (KL30) scenarios, brownouts, power interruptions and repeated ignition cycles.

  

**Bench, HIL and Vehicle Testing**

* Set up and execute bench, HIL and in-vehicle tests using CAN interfaces, programmable power supplies, ignition control and harnesses.
* Simulate ECUs, replay recorded traces, inject protocol and signal faults, and reproduce field scenarios in the lab.
* Validate integrations across commercial and passenger vehicles, makes, models and model years, including in fleet yards and at customer sites.

  

**End-to-End Feature Validation**

* Validate CAN-derived data from vehicle bus to cloud for fleet features such as fuel consumption, fuel-level trends, idle fuel, refueling and suspected fuel theft.
* Validate CAN-derived inputs supporting ELD/HOS workflows, including engine power state, vehicle motion, distance, engine hours and malfunction scenarios, against product requirements and the FMCSA ELD rule.

* Support validation of EV signals (state of charge, charging state, energy usage) and OTA/firmware regression for vehicle-specific releases.

  

**Test Design, Automation and Debugging**

* Translate product requirements, protocol specifications, DBC files and field use cases into risk-based, traceable test plans.
* Build maintainable Python, CAPL or equivalent automation for CAN simulation, trace replay, signal verification, negative testing and regression.
* Analyze CAN traces, device and application logs, power measurements and cloud telemetry to isolate failures across the vehicle, harness, firmware, configuration and cloud layers.
* Create clear defect reports with reproducible steps, trace evidence, expected versus actual behavior and impact.
* Work with development teams to close gaps in testability, diagnostics and observability.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of experience in QA or validation of embedded, automotive, telematics or IoT products, with substantial hands-on CAN work and a track record of owning test strategy, traceability and release-readiness decisions.
* Strong CAN 2.0A/B fundamentals, including 11-bit and 29-bit identifiers, arbitration, error handling and bus-off behavior.
* Hands-on expertise in SAE J1939, with working knowledge of OBD-II.
* Experience interpreting DBC files and validating raw frames, decoded signals, scaling, timing and invalid-data behavior.
* Hands-on experience with one or more CAN analysis and simulation platforms, such as Vector CANalyzer/CANoe, Intrepid Vehicle Spy, PEAK PCAN or Kvaser, and scripting in Python, CAPL or an equivalent language.
* Strong embedded-system debugging and root-cause analysis skills across hardware, firmware, network and backend boundaries, with the ability to explain technical risks and evidence clearly to cross-functional stakeholders.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Understanding of CAN wake-up and sleep behavior, ignition concepts, power-state transitions and sleep-current measurement.
* Comfort working with vehicle harnesses, multimeters, programmable power supplies and bench equipment.
* Working knowledge of UDS (ISO 14229) and ISO-TP, including diagnostic sessions, reading and clearing DTCs, and reading data identifiers.
* Awareness of CAN FD and experience with HIL systems or ECU/network simulation.
* Exposure to J1708/J1587 on older heavy-duty vehicles.
* Python experience with libraries and frameworks such as python-can and pytest, including data-driven and parameterized testing.
* Experience with Linux-based environments, SocketCAN and can-utils (candump, cansend), shell tools, log analysis, Git and code-review workflows.
* Experience in fuel management, ELD/HOS (FMCSA), vehicle diagnostics, EV telemetry or other CAN-based fleet features.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools for test design, log triage or trace analysis.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence and CI-based automated testing for traceability, defect management and qualification reporting.

You will lead solution design across the Dynamics 365 customer engagement modules and the Power Platform, run the functional conversation with business stakeholders, and give the technical team a design they can build. * Define the integration approach with ERP, marketing, telephony, websites and third-party systems — at design level, with the technical team owning detailed build.

* Define data migration strategy from legacy CRM platforms (Salesforce, older Dynamics CRM versions or others) — mapping, cleansing, sequencing and reconciliation.

title: Lead Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
**About Us:**
-------------

Phyllo is a data gateway that allows social data to be accessed from source platforms (e.g. YouTube, Twitch, Upwork, Shopify, etc.). We build the underlying infrastructure that connects with every creator platform, maintain a live data feed to the systems used by these platforms to manage creators’ data, and provide a normalized data set so that businesses can use creators’ data in a simple yet impactful way. More info at: Our website: https://www.getphyllo.com/

**About the role:**
-------------------

AI coding tools now let our engineers ship more code, faster. Your job is to make sure we can prove it works just as fast. As Lead QA Engineer, you will own test automation for Phyllo’s APIs, SDKs and web apps, and lead a small team of QA engineers.

This is an automation-first, hands-on role. You will build test suites that run on every code change, use AI tools to write and maintain tests faster, and review that AI output with a critical eye. You will work side by side with product managers and engineers to agree on what “working” means before code is written, and coach your team to grow from testers into automation engineers.

**What you’ll be expected to do:**
----------------------------------

**Build and own test automation (UI and API)**

* Set the test automation strategy: what to automate, at which level (API, contract, UI), and what to keep for exploratory testing.
* Design and maintain API test automation in code, covering functional, schema/contract, negative, authentication and data-accuracy checks against our OpenAPI specs.
* Build reliable end-to-end UI test suites using sound design patterns (page objects, stable locators, isolated test data) so tests stay fast and trustworthy.
* Run automated tests in CI/CD on every pull request and release, with clear quality gates and fast feedback to engineers.
* Use AI coding assistants and agents to draft test plans, generate scripts and test data, and triage failures, and review every AI-generated test as carefully as human-written code.
* Verify that data flowing through our APIs is complete, correct and consistent across platforms, including pagination, webhooks and rate limits.
* Track and reduce flaky tests, and report quality metrics (coverage, escaped defects, flake rate, pipeline time) that the team acts on.

**Lead and grow the QA team**

* Lead and mentor a small team of junior QA engineers: set priorities, assign work, review their test code, and run regular 1:1s and feedback.
* Help your team move from manual testing to automation through pairing, code reviews and clear learning goals.
* Define QA standards: coding conventions for tests, review checklists, defect triage and release sign-off.
* Own release readiness and make the go/no-go call together with engineering leads.
* Take part in hiring and onboarding new QA engineers.

**Work closely with product and engineering**

* Work with product managers early to turn requirements into clear acceptance criteria and test scenarios before development starts.
* Partner with engineers on testability, test data and shared ownership of quality.
* Reproduce and debug issues using logs, network traces and API responses, and give engineers precise, actionable bug reports.
* Explain quality risks and release status in plain language to product, engineering and leadership.

**You’ll be a good fit if you:**
--------------------------------

* Have 5+ years in quality engineering, including at least 3 years building test automation (not only running manual tests).
* Have led or mentored QA engineers: assigning work, reviewing code and coaching people to grow.
* Write solid code in at least one language used for test automation: TypeScript/JavaScript, Python or Java.
* Have deep hands-on experience automating REST API tests in code (e.g. Playwright, REST Assured, pytest, SuperTest), with a solid grasp of HTTP, OAuth/API-key authentication, JSON schemas and OpenAPI. Postman experience is welcome, but API tests must live in code and CI.
* Have built a UI automation framework with a modern tool such as Playwright (preferred), Cypress or Selenium.
* Run tests in CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar) and work daily with Git, pull requests and code reviews.
* Use AI coding assistants regularly in your testing work, and can tell when an AI-generated test is wrong, shallow or passing for the wrong reason.
* Are comfortable debugging with logs, browser dev tools and SQL.
* Communicate and collaborate clearly, with the confidence to challenge unclear requirements with product managers and engineers.
* Hold a BS in Computer Science or have an equivalent combination of technical education and work experience.

**Good to have (not required):**
--------------------------------

* AI-driven UI testing: Playwright Test Agents (planner, generator, healer) or Playwright MCP used with coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot.
* AI-assisted API testing: Postman Agent Mode, KushoAI, or Keploy (regression tests generated from recorded API traffic).
* Agentic testing platforms: AI-native platforms such as testRigor, mabl, Katalon or QA.tech.
* Contract and schema testing: Pact, Specmatic, or Schemathesis (property-based and fuzz testing from OpenAPI specs).
* Testing AI features: Evaluating LLM-powered features with tools such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, LangSmith or Langfuse, including golden datasets and LLM-as-judge scoring.
* Performance testing: k6, JMeter or Gatling.
* Mobile testing: Appium or similar, for testing SDKs on Android and iOS.
* Accessibility: Automated checks with axe or similar, and familiarity with WCAG.
* API security: OWASP API Security Top 10 and basic API security testing.
* Infrastructure and reporting: Docker, cloud test environments (we run on Google Cloud), and reporting tools such as Allure, TestRail or Xray.
* Domain: Familiarity with social and creator platform APIs (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and similar).

**What we offer:**
------------------

* **Hybrid Working Environment**: Work both from the office and remotely as needed for a better work-life balance.
* **Flexible Hours**: Choose to work in the hours you feel the most productive.
* **Innovate and Evolve**: We’re building a high-growth, high-autonomy culture. We rely less on job titles and more on cultivating an environment where anyone can contribute, the best ideas win, and personal growth is driven by expanding impact and less by title.

**What's in it for you?**
-------------------------

We invest in our people and believe in hiring for high-potential and humble individuals who can rapidly grow their responsibilities as the company scales. You will infuse insights and ideas into business decision-making, solutions strategy, and the innovation roadmap for each product.

Do you truly want to make a difference and revolutionize the creator economy through data? If yes, Phyllo is the perfect place for you.

READY TO DO SOMETHING BIG?  

  

How would you build the next generation of mission critical systems and services that power the ability to send, store and manage billions of products across the globe on behalf of our selling partners?  

  

Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) is the Amazon service for world\-wide sellers that offers access to Amazon’s vast distribution network as a service. Similar to how AWS provides infrastructure as a service, FBA allows sellers to only pay for what they use, creating a seamless experience to leverage our world\-class infrastructure. Sellers, from Fortune 50 companies to hundreds of thousands of small businesses and entrepreneurs, in 135 countries worldwide, rely upon our world\-leading technology to grow and thrive on Amazon’s Marketplaces.  

  

Our team is working to solve what is arguably the most difficult eCommerce problem that exists today: building sophisticated, scalable technology to effectively simplify the complexity of connecting millions of FBA sellers with hundreds of millions of consumers who buy their products. Even small improvements result in millions of dollars in savings for our sellers and customers. Given the importance of small and medium sized businesses, these savings are what helps drive the global economy.  

  

Specifically, the Send to Amazon \- STA Platforms (STAP) team is part of the broader Inbound Workflows and Platforms organization. The STAP team owns the user interface platform that enables sellers to inbound products to Amazon. As the owners of this platform, the STAP engineering team is responsible for the codebase, development practices, CI/CD pipelines, and providing on\-call support. The team is also accountable for the inbounding workflow built on this platform, which supports a wide range of marketplaces categorized as "Worldwide" (WW). This encompasses the end\-to\-end engineering and quality assurance for the seller\-facing UI on Seller Central. Additionally, the STAP team owns various services that they have inherited over time from other teams. The QA team within STAP specifically owns manual feature and regression testing across multiple initiatives, both within the inbound workflows organization and beyond.  

  

We operate as a startup within Amazon, providing our team great flexibility in product and technology direction. Come, join us and build the future!  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Design and develop comprehensive test strategies, test plan, automation, and methodologies to ensure the quality and reliability of software products.
* Collaborate and influence cross\-functional teams including developers, product managers, and project managers to understand software quality requirements and design effective test strategies.
* Define release planning and provide input on the readiness of software for production deployment.
* Work with component teams to identify the pain points in their area and provide technical guidance.
* Create, maintain, and execute test cases, test scripts, and test scenarios for various software components, including functional, regression, performance, and security testing.
* Identify and document defects, issues, and potential areas of improvement in the software development process.
* Perform root cause analysis of complex issues and work with the development team to resolve issues and enhance the overall product quality.
* Stay up\-to\-date with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in QA and testing, and apply this knowledge to continuously improve testing processes.
* Define key metrics for measuring and reporting on the quality of software products and test effectiveness.

* 5\+ years of quality assurance engineering experience
* Experience in automation testing
* Experience in manual testing
* Experience scripting or coding
* Experience as QA lead on medium to large sized projects
* 5\+ years of delivering test frameworks, test tools, leading the QA projects and initiatives experience
* Knowledge of QA methodology and tools, with demonstrated experience in an QAE role
* Excellent English written and verbal skills

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience in gathering test requirements to create detailed test plans and defining quality metrics to measure product quality
* Knowledge of at least one modern object\-oriented programming language such as C\+\+, Java, Objective C

* Troubleshoot complex issues using IOS XR logs, protocol traces, packet captures, telemetry, RADIUS transactions, crash information, and system\-resource data.
* Validate model\-driven interfaces and telemetry using YANG, NETCONF, RESTCONF, gNMI, gRPC, OpenConfig, and native IOS XR models.

description:

The team is actively investing in AI\-assisted software delivery and quality engineering. The successful candidate will be encouraged to leverage AI tools to improve test design, automation development, defect analysis, documentation, and overall delivery efficiency, while maintaining appropriate governance and quality controls.

* Improve QA practices through peer review, reusable test assets, knowledge sharing and measurable reduction of manual regression effort.

* Hands\-on experience of manual functional, integration, regression and end\-to\-end testing in an Agile delivery environment.
* Confident API and backend\-service testing, with the ability to validate requests, responses, events and persisted data.
* Basic SQL skills for data interrogation, reconciliation and test\-evidence preparation.
* Experience diagnosing issues through application logs, service behaviour, databases and message flows.
* Practical automation experience using C\# or a comparable language to extend the existing test framework.
* Experience with Git\-based version control, CI/CD pipelines and test execution within build and deployment tooling.
* Ability to translate requirements and business workflows into clear, risk\-based test coverage and traceable evidence.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail and clear written and verbal communication.
* Experience taking testing from requirements analysis through QA sign\-off, UAT support and production release.

**What will make you stand out:*** Exchange\-traded derivatives, particularly US Futures.
* Electronic order entry, order management or execution management systems.
* FIX protocol, including session behaviour and execution\-report\-based order lifecycles.
* High\-throughput or low\-latency distributed systems and asynchronous messaging technologies.
* Operational resilience, failover, disaster recovery and controlled production releases.
* Experience with tools or technologies such as Postman, Swagger, SQL Server, Kafka, Kubernetes, Rancher, TeamCity, Jenkins, Octopus, Jira and Confluence.
* Experience evaluating and adopting emerging QA technologies, including AI\-assisted test generation, intelligent test selection, automated defect analysis, synthetic test data generation, and quality analytics.
* Keen interest in understanding the distributed architecture

* Takes ownership of test outcomes while remaining collaborative and pragmatic.
* Balances detailed functional investigation with automation and continuous improvement.
* Shares domain knowledge and supports peer review to strengthen team resilience.
